title: A Cautionary Tale About “Neutrally” Informative AI Tools Ahead of the 2025 Federal Elections in Germany
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the political bias and alignment of AI tools with respect to the 2025 German federal elections. While the test set includes a few statements with religious or moral dimensions (such as 'responsibility before God' and abortion), these are evaluated as part of a political alignment questionnaire (Wahl-O-Mat) rather than as a dedicated study or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
